title: barbarahelena/osmoflow pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. Each row is either FASTQ reads (fastq_1[, fastq_2]) to be run through 'osmotool profile', or an assembly (fasta) to be run through 'osmotool annotate' -- not both.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fasta.errorMessage: Assembly file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fasta', '.fa' or '.fna' (optionally gzipped)

items.errorMessage: Each row must provide either 'fastq_1' (reads, for osmotool profile) or 'fasta' (assembly, for osmotool annotate), but not both
